results.name: Stegosaurus stenops vs Allosaurus fragilis
results.description:
This WIP depicts an adult Stegosarus protecting it's offspring from an Allosaurus attack. Modeling the rib cages is proving to be particularly difficult due to severe occlusion as well as the complex background of the exhibit.

Created using 171 exposures.

On permanent display at the Denver Museum of Nature and Science

Photoreconstruction by David Romero; Sept 2016

8.64 million --> 864K
